thread:
Aisha: FYI ZephyrCloud (top5 account) just asked to move private deployment cutover to 2025-06-15. Need to triage asks and confirm what we can commit in current Q.
Marcus: noted. They want KMS + HSM integration, 99.9% SLA, and a dedicated pool. Are they asking for dedicated capacity or private (VPC)?
Aisha: Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS. They confirmed on today's call: must be FIPS + HSM. Also want model pinning and A/B rollback in console.
Priya: HSM + FIPS adds ~4-6w of engineering depending on HSM vendor. Also need network egress controls for air-gapped option. SE prep: do we have an integration checklist?
Diego: From infra side, biggest risk is KMS/HSM cert flow + onboarding. We should add gating criteria: KMS test harness, e2e key rotation test, and a mock cutover run in staging.
Aisha: Good. Let's draft acceptance criteria. I'm thinking:
- KMS/HSM integration validated in staging
- Private control plane reachable from Zephyr VPC
- Model version pinning + canary rollout config
- SLA playbook + oncall escalation path
- SOW + security addendum signed
Marcus: I can own SOW + commercial commit. Timeline: need signed SOW by 5/10 to meet 6/15 cutover. Will push.
Priya: SE tasks: HSM vendor connector (2w), key rotation CI (1w), networking playbook (1w). Need Diego to allocate a node team for cert provisioning.
Diego: I can allocate a small infra rotation for cert flow, but full automation after cutover. We need a temporary runbook for manual cert provisioning.
Harjot: ops-bot created a ticket: INF-4321 ZephyrCloud HSM onboarding. Link: https://z/repo/INF-4321 :memo:
ops-bot: Deployment checklist template applied to INF-4321
Aisha: OK. For roadmap/OKR call: propose adding a 'Private: Enterprise compliance enablement' sub-initiative for Q2 with owners Aisha/Marcus/Priya. We'd commit to gating criteria and delivery runway if SOW signed by 5/10.
Marcus: +1. Also flag cost impact—dedicated pool + HSM ops will add to pricing. I'll model pricing tiers and present Monday.
Priya: One more ask from Zephyr: they want pre-warmed cache and prefix caching enabled. That's fairly straightforward; I'll add it to SE runbook.
Diego: Risks noted: SLA target may need dedicated capacity. We'll list fallback: hosted with strict egress controls if private take too long.
Aisha: Great. Action items:
- Marcus: SOW + pricing by 5/10
- Priya: SE runbook + HSM connector estimate by 4/28
- Diego: cert provisioning runbook by 4/28
- Aisha: Draft acceptance criteria doc and present at roadmap sync on 4/30
Marcus: I'll loop in Legal for the security addendum now.
Priya: Any test data concerns? We should confirm encryption-in-transit + at-rest test vectors with Zephyr security.
Aisha: I'll request their security contact and get test matrix. Thanks all :rocket:
